concepts.name: Ranger — Thorn Crown
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body elite Runelord hero concept, a polished high-detail 2D cel-shaded game character on genuine transparent background. Image 1 is the newer Runeblade and image 2 the newer Warlock Seraph: match their elite visual presence, sculpted angular equipment, decisive layered silhouettes, crisp faceted cel shading and finish, but do not copy their class equipment or wings. Image 3 is the existing basic version of this subject: retain its recognizable character identity and class palette as a general starting direction while dramatically upgrading the design. Serious mature expression, bold clean color masses, designed bevels, hard shadow shapes, restrained runic glow, no realistic painting or PBR, no cute or chibi face. Full silhouette, boots and weapon tips within generous 8 percent padding. Neutral ready stance, shallow three-quarter view facing screen-right, stable feet, leg and arm separation. No text, scenery, pedestal, inset, alternate poses, companions or extra figures. Elite female elf archer with long pale-blonde hair, pointed ears and stern emerald eyes. Regal woodland huntress, crown of swept dark antlers with emerald centerpiece; tailored deep moss cloak split into elegant long leaf-shaped panels, layered dark bark leather and beautifully sculpted antique silver leaf armor on shoulders, vambraces, shins; commanding but agile silhouette. Majestic enormous recurved living-wood longbow with silver thorn fittings, emerald runic channels and clearly visible taut string, carried upright in left hand, right hand relaxed near an arrow on belt. Quiver, small restrained bone companion charms. More sophisticated and dangerous than basic ranger; high-ranking forest sovereign without royal gown. Green and bark palette, silver edges.
